items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: he was slapping that bass like Pops Foster.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Plucking that Bass and I think he wasn't too satisfied with it. And Benny Payne said 'well just stay right there and hit an F chord or something.' I just forget now, just how the conversation went down, but he was slapping that bass like Pops Foster.
Were you and Milt pretty close?
